Fixed in d53e24174. The schema payload builder now emits explicit answer_fact_allowed / provisional_safe_context_allowed posture fields and only marks provisional_safe assertions as downgraded context when that posture permits it. The schema validator now rejects downgraded_context_eligible=true when provisional_safe_context_allowed is false, and the regression suite includes the tampered blocked-posture case.
